title: PAD unit plan export
description: DRAFT 0.1. One unit plan exported from PAD (Patry Analysis & Design). Metres. x runs left to right; y runs down the page from the window wall (y = 0) to the corridor (y = depth). To draw in DXF, use x' = x and y' = depth - y, and negate rotations. Sample: sample-A1-4.1.pad.json. Field notes: EXPORT.md.

version.description: Schema version. Breaking changes raise the first number.

depth.description: Unit depth, window wall to corridor. Use it for y' = depth - y.

shape.description: The building's shape: one straight corridor (bar), two wings (L) or three wings around a courtyard (U).

wing.description: The wing the unit is on. Null for a straight building.

name.description: For example West wing, North bar, East wing.

index.description: 1 for the first wing, counting along the corridor from one end of the building.

heading.description: Direction of travel along this wing's corridor, degrees clockwise from north. The unit's window wall (y=0) faces 90 degrees to the left of it, its corridor wall to the right.

id.description: Unit name plus version, for example PAD-01-v2. Unique inside one project.

name.description: The unit's name in PAD, for example PAD-01.

brief.description: Who the unit is for, in the owner's words, for example Two construction worker roommates. Null for baseline units.

unitType.description: For example 1 BED, 2 BED CORNER, MIN. STUDIO.

corner.description: Corner unit: the side with the extra exterior wall.

version.description: 1 is the original layout; each saved change adds one.

name.description: What was asked for or changed, in words.

catalogId.description: The baseline layout this unit started from, when it started from one.

printedNetFt2.description: Net area printed on the source drawing, ft2.

netM2.description: PAD net area. Sum of PAD room areas less area taken out by bump-ins (a recessed balcony or vestibule).

unitGrossM2.description: Unit to its wall centrelines, with bump-outs added and bump-ins taken out.

corridorShareM2.description: Half of a 1.6 m shared corridor across the unit's width.

layerMap.description: Layer names from the Revit DXF export that each kind of object is meant to land on.

dimensions.description: Only dimensions a person added in PAD.

polygon.description: Closed ring, first point not repeated. Clockwise on the page.

tag.description: The Revit room tag it maps to: LIVING, KITCHEN, BEDROOM, DEN, W/C, HALL, CLOSET, LAUNDRY, HVAC, DINING, WALK-IN, STUDY, ENTRY.

tagMatchesRevit.description: False when PAD has a name the Revit tags do not have; the tag is then the PAD name in capitals.

holes.description: Rings to cut out of the polygon, such as a closet standing inside the room.

extraParts.description: Further separate pieces of the same room, when walls split it.

areaM2.description: PAD's area. This is the area PAD adds up for the net area. Use it for area text.

areaSF.description: areaM2 in ft2, rounded, as the Revit area labels show it (for example 107 SF).

polygonAreaM2.description: Area of polygon minus holes, 50 mm resolution. Differs from areaM2 on plans imported from a drawing: see EXPORT.md.

labelPoint.description: Where PAD puts the room name; use it for the A-AREA-IDEN text.

isBumpRoom.description: A den or nook that sticks out of the front wall.

kind.description: exterior: window wall and balcony, bump-out or recess walls, plus the side wall of a corner unit. demising: the corridor wall and the side walls shared with the next unit. partition: every other wall. guard: a balcony railing. PAD does not model structure: no wall is marked bearing.

segments.description: The solid pieces of this wall. Doorways and window gaps lie between them.

jamb.description: A short piece beside a door, under 300 mm.

wallId.description: The wall the door sits in. Null when the PAD plan has no wall run there (see wallNote).

centre.description: Centre of the opening on the wall centreline.

offsetAlongWall.description: From the wall's start (left end of a horizontal wall, top end of a vertical one) to the centre of the opening.

hingeSide.description: Which end of the opening the hinge is at, along the wall direction (left to right, or top to bottom).

closedDirection.description: Unit vector from the hinge along the closed leaf.

openDirection.description: Unit vector from the hinge along the open leaf. Which side of the wall the door swings into.

clockwiseOnPage.description: Direction from -> to as drawn with y down the page. Reverse it after flipping y for DXF.

fromRoomId.description: Room on the hinge side, null for the corridor. Approximate on plans imported from a drawing.

revitBlock.description: Block name when the door came from a Revit block. Null for now: PAD does not keep block names.

revitBlockSuggested.description: Block name stem from the Revit sample (without the trailing element id) that suits this door.

offsetAlongWall.description: May be negative when the glass starts before the wall run does.

sideWall.description: On the side wall of a corner unit.

id.description: Unit name, version and a number, for example PAD-01-v1-F07. Stable for one saved version. A layout change places furniture afresh, so the numbers start again.

padKind.description: PAD's internal kind, for example bed, wc, counter.

width.description: Along the piece's own x axis before rotation.

depth.description: Along its own y axis before rotation. Clearance zones, such as the chairs of a table, are not included.

rotationDeg.description: Degrees clockwise on the page, 0 to 359. 0 puts the back of the piece to y smaller (the window wall); negate it for DXF after flipping y.

revitBlock.description: Block name when the piece came from a Revit block. Null for now.

revitBlockSuggested.description: Block name stem from the Revit sample that suits this piece, or null where the sample has none.

layer.description: I-FURN, P-SANR-FIXT, Q-CASE, Q-CASE-HDLN or Q-SPCQ.
